newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade on slaughter steers and heifers was fairly active on Thursday, USDA said. Prices both classes steady to $1.00 higher on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and seller interest good.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1325 lbs 65.50-67.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1275 lbs 65.00-67.00.
Dressed Basis Delivered. (paid on hot carcass weights) Steers and heifers steady to 1.00 higher.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs 109.00 to mostly 110.00. ( weighted average 109.58 ).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 109.00 to mostly 110.00. ( weighted average 109.74 )

For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis steady to mostly 1.00 higher, dressed basis 2.00-3.00 higher. Weekly total includes 9,100 formulated and/or previously contracted cattle. Confirmed - 26,400 Last Week - 7,700 Last Year - 14,000 Wk To Date- 53,700 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 56,800 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 59,200
